text: Code reviews are a vital part of modern software development. When a developer finishes writing a piece of code, a colleague reviews it before it is merged into the main project. This process is excellent for catching bugs early, as a fresh pair of eyes often spots mistakes that the original writer missed. Beyond fixing errors, code reviews are a powerful tool for knowledge sharing. Team members learn new techniques and become more familiar with different parts of the codebase. Ultimately, this practice raises the overall quality of the team's work, encouraging clear communication and better coding standards.
